about: MUTATING — cuts the one-stick recovery kit (infra/forge/recovery-kit.sh --assemble; backlog c1bb822e). Authorized by David 2026-09-29 (the packet's david_decisions_2026_09_29: an ordinary stick, gpg symmetric encryption, the passphrase his alone and typed only into gpg's prompt, and the Talos secrets bundle derived by BOSS because nobody holds it). It mounts a root-only tmpfs at /run/boss-recovery-kit (noswap where the kernel has it, a named WARNING where swap is on and it does not) and PROVES it is one before any credential is read; from then until the kit is whole an EXIT trap discards it, so a killed cut leaves nothing resident. It takes the forge archive through forge-backup.sh (forgejo dump, the consistent copy, registry skipped), /etc/boss-publish/github.token, /etc/boss-ops/talosconfig and kubeconfig, the forgejo-runner registration from its unit's WorkingDirectory, /etc/sudoers.d, and the offsite bucket's key from Secret boss/boss-gcs-offsite (every talosctl and kubectl call under a timeout); it derives the Talos secrets bundle from a control-plane node's config and proves it by effect — its os CA must equal the talosconfig's and its k8s CA the kubeconfig's, or talos/ is dropped and named MISSING REFUSED while the rest of the kit stands. Its recorded output is the MANIFEST (names, sizes, sha256, completeness, what is MISSING — never a value) and the one line that writes a stick from any machine on the estate's tunnel: bash infra/forge/write-recovery-kit.sh <version> STICK_MOUNT_PATH, run from a checkout, reaching the kit only through the root-owned reader /usr/local/libexec/boss/recovery-kit-read that install.sh installs with its one sudoers rule. Takes nothing from the packet. The kit stays in RAM until a write reads back, discard-recovery-kit, the next cut or a reboot; the reader refuses one older than 24h. Exit 0 complete, 3 cut with items MISSING, 1 nothing kept. Its own timeout: a forge dump outlasts the runner's 30s default.
effect: ^COMPLETE — kit [0-9a-f]{12} is cut: [0-9]+ items, every one present[.]$
